# Alamin — Senior Full-Stack Engineer

> Developer Alamin (Alamin developer) — senior full-stack engineer specializing in NestJS, React, Next.js, MongoDB, AWS, SaaS, and AI/ML web development.

## About

Alamin is a senior full-stack engineer with 5+ years of experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms serving 60,000+ clients in production. Currently leading architecture at Candy Melon Software GmbH (Austria) for RepairCMS, and building Asklytics — an indie AI analytics product — on the side.

Expertise: NestJS, React, Next.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, AWS (EC2/S3/SES), Stripe, Socket.IO, OpenAI integration, NLP, RAG, SaaS architecture, CI/CD, performance engineering.

## Projects

- [RepairCMS](https://repaircms.com) — Multi-tenant enterprise SaaS for repair/service businesses. NestJS, Next.js, MongoDB, Stripe, AWS. CRM, POS, inventory, cashbook, form-builder, quotes, customer portal.
- [Asklytics](https://asklytics.app) — AI-driven analytics SaaS with natural-language query engine (NL→SQL). Built solo with NestJS, OpenAI, Next.js, MongoDB.
- [LSOE CRM](https://app.londonschoolofexcellence.com/) — Education CRM with 5-tier RBAC and real-time Socket.IO collaboration. NestJS, Next.js, MongoDB.
- [SRH](https://www.srhlabsa.com) — Corporate platform for Saudi engineering consultancy. Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, AWS.

## Services

- SaaS Application Development — multi-tenant architecture, Stripe billing, CI/CD to AWS
- AI / ML Integration — FastAPI/Flask microservices, NLP, RAG-powered search, OpenAI
- Performance Engineering — MongoDB aggregation tuning, Redis caching, sub-second search over 20M+ records
